descripcion: The 12 Step Meeting List WordPress plugin before 3.19.17 does not sanitise and escape a value submitted by unauthenticated users before storing it in its activity log and outputting it back in an admin area page, leading to a Stored Cross-Site Scripting issue which could be used against high privilege users such as admin. 27/08/2026 27/08/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The Notifima WordPress plugin before 3.1.4 does not verify that the caller owns the subscription being modified on one of its REST endpoints in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.3, allowing authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access to unsubscribe arbitrary customers from product stock-alert notifications. 27/08/2026 27/08/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The Finale Lite WordPress plugin before 2.21.0 does not perform a capability check on an AJAX action that returns a sales-campaign's configuration for an arbitrary post ID, allowing any authenticated user (Subscriber and above) to read the Finale Lite WordPress plugin before 2.21.0's campaign configuration and scheduling data. 27/08/2026 27/08/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The StoreGrowth WordPress plugin before 2.1.2 does not validate a browser-supplied product price on two of its unauthenticated actions, allowing unauthenticated attackers to add a product to the cart at an arbitrary, attacker-chosen price that carries through to the checkout total when the BOGO offer feature is enabled. 27/08/2026 27/08/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

The LearnPress WordPress plugin before 4.0.3 does not perform any authorization check on one of its REST endpoints in all versions up to, and including, 4.0.2, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose the payment status of arbitrary orders by enumerating order identifiers. 27/08/2026 27/08/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis
